contexts.text: The lovers with whom the perverted Church is said to have scortated () = those who pervert goods and truths. ( = those who falsify. AC 10402:5).
By the lovers who shall go away into captivity () are signified the delights of the loves of self and of the world, and the derivative delights of evils; lovers = these delights.
I will stir up thy lovers against thee, the sons of Babel... () = the destruction of the Church through the evils of the love of self...
By the baals and lovers after whom she went () are signified those things which are of the natural man and are loved; namely, cupidities, and the derivative Falsities.
By lovers (), in the abstract sense, are signified the truths of the Church.
